_why: THE DERIVATION RECORD of every product screenshot nikatru.com serves (sites/*/apps/shots/). Each web copy is
a store-screenshot capture frame, shrunk for the page; this file records which frame, and the bytes of both.
tooling/ci/check-site-integrity.mjs reads it and fails a served screenshot with no entry, a served file whose
bytes differ from `sha256`, a `from` that is not a frame of a live capture (its CAPTURE.json), and a frame
that no longer hashes to `sourceSha256` (the store set was re-captured; the site must follow).
Re-deriving: run `derivation.command` per frame, with the NEXT version in the web name (`-v2` -> `-v3`;
sites/nikatru/_headers serves /*.webp immutable, so a new picture needs a new URL), delete the old files,
run node tooling/sites/generate-discovery.mjs, and re-record each entry's sha256, bytes and sourceSha256.
O-SITE-SCREENSHOTS-STALE (2026-10-02): the previous web copies showed the retired name and an offline banner.

derivation.method: resize to 540x960 (exactly half of the 1080x1920 Play frame), Lanczos, strip metadata, WebP q72 method 6
derivation.tool: ImageMagick 6 with libwebp 1.3.2 (the same command on another libwebp can produce other bytes; re-record then)
